verdict.rationale: Jitsu supports batching of event delivery, deduplication of repeated sends, and connector syncs that pull large volumes of data into a warehouse, plus a CLI that manages multiple workspace config objects — all of which imply some bulk/batch data handling. However, there is no explicit bulk-operation API or CLI command for acting on many discrete items (e.g., bulk edit/delete of profiles, destinations, or events) beyond individual config management. Missing for 10: a documented bulk API/CLI command operating on many items at once, evidence of batch profile/record updates, and independent confirmation of bulk workflows in practice.
